create.name: Simon Borg-Olivier
create.bio:
Simon Borg-Olivier is an Australian yoga teacher and physiotherapist who has spent more than four decades looking for the common ground between yoga, qigong, the internal martial arts and Western physiology. His interest in the breath began in childhood, when his father taught him to hold his breath, and as a teenager he studied tantric yoga with a Tibetan lama. In the early 1980s he trained with B.K.S. Iyengar, K. Pattabhi Jois and T.K.V. Desikachar, then spent fifteen years with Shandor Remete of Shadow Yoga, later adding Wing Chun kung fu and Chinese internal arts. Alongside this he took science degrees at the University of Sydney and qualified as a physiotherapist.

In Sydney he and Bianca Machliss developed the Yoga Synergy approach together and co-wrote the book Applied Anatomy and Physiology of Yoga. Since about 2010 his own focus has been 5-Dimensional Synergy Flow, a system of fluid, breath-led movement from the centre of the body that he teaches as a moving meditation, calming rather than straining. He teaches online through recorded courses, a membership and a 200-hour teacher training with live Zoom sessions, and has led workshops across Asia, Europe and the Americas. He lives in the Byron Bay area of New South Wales, where he holds small in-person workshops and retreats.

courses.title: 5-Dimensional Synergy Flow 200h Online Teacher Training
courses.description: A 200-hour training in his integrated method of yoga, qigong, breath control and applied anatomy, with more than fifty hours of live Zoom classes and a year of access to recordings. Open to teachers and committed practitioners, with enrolment at any time.

courses.title: 5D Flow Mastery
courses.description: His in-depth online course in 5-Dimensional Flow: wave-like, breath-led movement from the core that draws on yoga, dance, martial arts and physiotherapy. Pitched at teacher-level depth.

courses.title: 5-Dimensional Flow Foundations
courses.description: A seven-week beginners' programme in the core principles of 5-Dimensional Flow, with progressive sequences for the spine, joints and breath.

courses.title: 21-Day 5D Flow Challenge (Kickstart)
courses.description: Three weeks of short guided sessions to build a daily habit of gentle, flowing movement, as an introduction to his method.

courses.title: Advanced Yoga Fundamentals
courses.description: The Yoga Synergy Fundamentals sequence taught in detail, explaining the inner actions behind each posture rather than only its outer shape.

courses.title: 84 Key Yoga Postures Unpacked
courses.description: About twenty hours of teaching on alignment, activation and breathing in 84 key asanas, with anatomical and physiological notes for each.

courses.title: Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga: Primary Series
courses.description: The Ashtanga primary series seen through movement science, with ways to adapt postures so the practice stays fluid and free of needless tension.

courses.title: Breath Control Foundations
courses.description: An online introduction to pranayama: returning to natural, quiet breathing and then learning five core breath-control techniques.

courses.title: Breath Control Mastery
courses.description: The follow-on breath course, with more advanced pranayama methods and longer breath retention for experienced practitioners.

free_resources.title: Bandha: The Key to Energy & Stability (free eBook)
free_resources.description: A free downloadable guide to the bandhas, explaining them through muscle co-activation, joint stability and breath control, with uses in asana and pranayama.

flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link.

HEALTH RULE BORDERLINE (please review): he is a physiotherapist and his site brand is 'Health, Happiness & Longevity'; it sells therapy courses (back pain, knee, circulation, yoga therapy), one-on-one consulting for pain and anxiety, free eBooks on knee pain and immunity, and even the 5D Flow sales pages list pain, immunity and disease benefits. I judged his main work to be yoga and movement teaching (teacher training, yoga and breath courses) and kept only those, with neutral descriptions; a stricter reading would skip him.
His old school site yogasynergy.com now says Yoga Synergy is solely owned and led by Bianca Machliss; his own site is simonborgolivier.com.
Base: home page says he hosts retreats in his own home (a geodesic dome) in Byron Bay Shire; recorded as Byron Bay, New South Wales. Regional: Northern Rivers NSW.
Email info@simonborgolivier.com is Cloudflare-obfuscated on the contact page (decoded); a team inbox.
Photo 2 is the YouTube avatar (an inverted pose on a beach, face small but visible); photo 1 is an uncaptioned portrait on his home page matching other photos of him on the site.
Free resource URL is the shared Free eBooks page (/resources), not a page unique to the Bandha eBook.
left_out: Therapy courses (Yoga Therapy, Back Pain Therapy, Knee Therapy Program, Circulatory Therapy), Joint Synergy Program, one-on-one consulting, 12 Pumps and knee masterclasses, and free eBooks on knee pain and whole-body health/immunity: health rule.
Applied Anatomy & Physiology of Yoga course and book: book ISBN not confirmable (Open Library refused connections on 4 Nov 2026); course left out as anatomy-led.
Byron Bay 6-day workshop (6-11 March 2027) and Sydney 5-day intensive (19-23 March 2027): no unique URL (only an events-page anchor); 7-day dome retreat is waitlist only.
Videos on back pain and lower back, 'Stopping heart with Yoga', 'Nervous System Reset' pranayama, and clips under two minutes.
